newsitem.title: CANADA: Brookfield buys World Financial stake.
newsitem.headline: Brookfield buys World Financial stake.

text.p: Brookfield Properties Corp on Thursday said it acquired a 46 percent in World Financial Properties Inc, making it the company's new controlling shareholder.
World Financial owns and operates three towers of the World Financial Center and One Liberty Plaza and 245 Park Avenue in Manhattan.
The Toronto-based real estate company did not disclose the price of the acquisition.
Brookfield, which was formerly known as Carena Developments Ltd, is majority owned by The Edper Group Ltd, which is controlled by the Bronfman family of Toronto.

Other major shareholders in World Financial Properties Inc include Citicorp unit Citibank N.A., the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, and Dragon Holdings, which is controlled by Hong Kong investor K.S. Li.
Brookfield said the acquisition is an excellent strategic fit with its growth orientation strategy.
